title: Mobile/touch: right Library/Properties pane obscures content & can't be resized on narrow viewports
description:
## Repro (mobile/narrow viewport)
On a narrow/mobile viewport, the right pane (Library/Properties tabs) takes a fixed slice of the layout and there is no way to collapse it or resize it by touch; it overlaps/squeezes the stage and chrome.

## Root cause (file:line)
Two coupled gaps — fixed pane width with no responsive collapse, and a mouse-only resize handle.
1. Fixed width, no responsive behavior:
   - packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx:412-420 (styles.rightPanel) — width:"240px", flexShrink:0. On a desktop layout it sits in a flex row (styles.centerRegion, Shell.tsx:394-399); on a narrow viewport the 240px non-shrinking pane eats most of the width, squeezing the main column/stage. There is NO @media / matchMedia / innerWidth responsive collapse anywhere (grep across packages/authoring-ui/src for matchMedia|@media|innerWidth|isMobile returns nothing).
   - The pane width is driven by rightResize.size (Shell.tsx:823 useResize(240,160,600,"x")) and rendered at Shell.tsx:3508 (width: rightResize.size). Min clamp is 160px and there is no collapse-to-0 / overlay toggle.
2. Resize handle is mouse-only:
   - packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx:3499-3505 — the vResizeHandle div wires onMouseDown={rightResize.onMouseDown} only.
   - packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx:488-531 (useResize) — onMouseDown registers document 'mousemove'/'mouseup' listeners. No pointer/touch path, so on a touch device the drag never starts and the pane cannot be resized by finger. (Same root cause family as the touch stage-drawing task; useResize is shared by timeline/bottom-dock resizers too.)

## Expected vs actual
- Expected: on a narrow viewport the right pane collapses or becomes a toggleable overlay so it doesn't obscure content; the resize handle is draggable by touch.
- Actual: the pane holds a fixed 240px+ width that overlaps/squeezes content on mobile and cannot be resized or collapsed by touch.

## Fix direction
- Make the right pane responsive: at a narrow breakpoint, collapse it (width 0) behind a toggle button, or render it as an overlay drawer rather than an inline flex column. Add a collapse/hide control to the right-panel tab strip (Shell.tsx:3509).
- Convert useResize (Shell.tsx:488-531) from mouse-only to Pointer Events (onPointerDown + document pointermove/pointerup, setPointerCapture), and bind it via onPointerDown on the handle (Shell.tsx:3502). This also fixes touch-resize of the timeline (Shell.tsx:825) and bottom dock (Shell.tsx:826).

## Classification
Mobile/touch is an UNSUPPORTED-PLATFORM GAP, not a regression (desktop-only Tauri editor; no responsive/touch code exists; no docs claim mobile). Priority medium. NOTE: the mouse-only useResize sub-issue shares its root cause (mouse-only handlers) with the touch stage-drawing task; converting useResize + StageArea handlers to Pointer Events is a coherent combined direction, but the responsive-collapse work here is distinct, so this is filed separately.

## References
- packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx:412-420 (styles.rightPanel fixed width), 488-531 (useResize mouse-only), 823 (rightResize), 3499-3508 (handle binding + pane render)
- Sibling tasks: touch stage-drawing, tap-selection (user-select).
